profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Instagram | Meta

positions.title: Founder & Lead Developer
positions.description:
http://nugenstudio.com

iOS Apps on App Store:
• DIYLandlord – a native iOS app allowing landlords to manage their rental business on mobile devices. 
• Social Networks Safe – a native iOS app protecting users’ social networking life.
• Daily To-Do List – an offline HTML5/CSS3 To-Do web app with local storage wrapped inside a UIWebView.
• Flying Justin Biebird - a Flappy Bird inspired game using Spritekit framework.
• TweetsMatter - the ONLY Twitter client app in the Appstore that can search tweets by number of followers, favorites and retweets.

positions.title: Senior Manager, iOS Engineering Lead
positions.description: Led diverse teams of engineers across the US and abroad, leveraging agile methodologies to drive the development of advanced iOS mobile solutions for the strategic Apple + IBM initiative, emphasizing speed, innovation, and high-impact collaboration.

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description: Led the full lifecycle development of iOS applications for Ora, crafting bespoke solutions that catered to the unique needs of Fortune 500 firms and startups, from inception through to deployment.

courses.name: Apple World Wide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2013, 2014, 2015 in-person attendee

volunteerExperiences.description: Served as a mentor for Prairie State College students at the Junior Energy 2015 event.
